columns_doc.annualized_mint_rate: minted_near / supply_before_near * 31536000 / epoch_seconds; equals max_inflation_rate when every validator is above the online threshold.
columns_doc.epoch_seconds: timestamp(last block of epoch E-1) - timestamp(last block of epoch E-2): the duration the mint at the start of epoch E pays for (nearcore finalize_epoch).
columns_doc.minted_near: supply(boundary) - supply(previous block) + sum(chunk.balance_burnt for chunks with height_included == boundary). On ordinary blocks supply delta + burnt == 0 exactly.
columns_doc.prev_boundary_height: first block of epoch E-1 (the boundary before this one): the block after the last block of E-2, prev_hash checked. The row below must carry this height.
columns_doc.supply_before_near: total_supply of the block before the boundary (the supply nearcore uses).

description: Supply minted at every epoch boundary from 2024-11-03 00:00 UTC (737 days before the latest full-day dense sample date) to the latest final block: the exact mint behind the trailing-year burn share, and cheap ground truth for current issuance.
incremental_rule: Boundary rows are immutable. The window is every boundary at or after 00:00 UTC 737 days before the latest full-day dense sample date (EPOCH_MINTS_DAYS or --epoch-days); rows older than that are dropped. The walk follows prev_boundary_height links through cached rows without RPC calls and fetches only where the cached chain breaks; a recomputed row must equal its cached copy. Progress is written every 25 fetched rows, so an interrupted walk resumes where it stopped.
method: Walk back from the tip: block(header.next_epoch_id) is the last block of the previous epoch; boundary = first block after it (prev_hash checked, epoch_id changes there). Each row links to the boundary before it (prev_boundary_height), found the same way, so the rows form one chain.
verified: 2026-11-10: treasury.near credit x 10 at boundaries 223962737 and 223919537 equals max_inflation_rate x supply_before x epoch_seconds / 31536000 within 10 yoctoNEAR.
